2  THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLE 226 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, PRAYING TO, I) ISSUE A WRIT OF CERTIORARI TO QUASH THE IMPUGNED ENDORSEMENT DATED 06-06-2023 ISSUED BY THE 3RD RESPONDENT BEARING NO.J.J.P:J/Dg-13/2023-24/170,168,166 AS AT ANNEXURE-O; II) ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS DIRECTING THE RESPONDENT NO.3 TO CONSIDER THE APPLICATION  -3-  NC: 2026:KHC-K:2712  WP No. 202314 of 2023 HC-KAR PREFERRED BY THE PETITIONERS INVOKING SEC.28(A) OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT, 1894 DATED 20-11-2006 AS AT ANNEXURE C,C1 AND C2 WITHIN SUCH STIPULATED TIME AS THIS COURT DEEMS FIT, IN THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE; III) TO ISSUE A WRIT OF MANDAMUS DIRECTING THE RESPONDENT 1 AND 2 TO HOLD NECESSARY ENQUIRY IN THE MATTER FOR PASSING IMPUGNED ORDER AND FOR SWEARING A WRONG AFFIDAVIT CONTRARY TO THE RECORDS; IV) PASS ANY SUCH ORDER'S AS THIS COURT DEEMS FIT IN THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER

Petitioners, who claim to be the owners of the land which was subject matter of the acquisition proceedings under the preliminary notification under Section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 [for brevity, 'the Act'] published in the Karnataka Gazette on 09.08.1973, had filed applications under Section 28-A of the Act vide Annexure-'C' series before respondent No.3 with a prayer to grant enhanced compensation in the light of the order passed by the Reference Court in LAC No.1/2005.
The said applications were considered and rejected by respondent No.3 vide endorsement dated 06.06.2023 at Annexure-O.
Aggrieved by the same, the petitioners are before this Court.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners, having reiterated the grounds urged in the writ petition,
submits NC: 2026:KHC-K:2712 HC-KAR that impugned endorsement has been issued by respondent No.3 on the ground that petitioners had not filed any application under Section 28-A of the Act and there was no record available in the office, relating to the application filed by the petitioners.

He submits that copy of the applications are produced at Annexure-C series and the said applications also bear the seal and signature of respondent No.3.
5.

Per contra, learned Additional Government Advocate, on instructions, submits that the applications filed by the petitioners under Section 28-A of the Act at Annexure-C series have been received in the office of respondent No.3 and the said applications shall be considered afresh and appropriate orders shall be passed in accordance with law in the light of the orders passed by the Reference Court in LAC No.1/2005.
6.
The said submission is placed on record.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:2712 HC-KAR 7.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER (i) The Writ Petition is allowed.
(ii) The impugned order/endorsement at Annexure-O dated 06.06.2023 bearing No.
J.J.P:J/Dg-13/2023-24/170,168,166 issued by respondent No.3 is quashed.

Revamma Died By Lrs A) Subhash And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 25 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81778234/
4 (iii) The matter is remitted to respondent No.3 to consider the applications of the petitioners at Annexure-C series submitted by them under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 in accordance with law and pass appropriate orders on the same, as expeditiously as possible, but not later than a period of four months from the date of receipt of copy of this order, after granting an opportunity of being heard to the petitioners.
